Class LightPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.lightmodel.LightPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerInterface, Serializable
public class LightPlayer extends Object implements PlayerInterface, Serializable
This class represents a light version of the player in the game. It contains the essential details about a player like their position, rank, credits, and their shipboard.

The class implements the PlayerInterface to provide the necessary methods for player management.
